DY loses 27.2% of its companies in two years against the 17.6% its mix predicts; BT loses 10.6% against 14.1%. Neither gap is about what those companies do.
The Black Country and Worcestershire — DY, WR, B, BL — sit furthest above the line, and they sit above it together, which a single-area story would have missed.
117 areas, 3,525,030 companies, 1,532 sector-by-type-by-vintage cells. A death is a disappearance between the 2024 and 2026 snapshots.
